summary: Build Pleiades TV, a video on-demand (VOD) app with subscriptions and social engagement features (comments, likes, sharing).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- App logo mark for “Pleiades TV” (pleiades-tv-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide header/hero background illustration with abstract star-cluster motif (pleiades-hero.dim_1600x400.png)
- Video thumbnail placeholder image (video-thumb-placeholder.dim_640x360.png)
- User avatar placeholder image (avatar-placeholder.dim_256x256.png)

existing_features.title: Create the Pleiades TV app shell with a coherent, distinctive visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) applied consistently across all pages. Use English for all user-facing text.
Implement Internet Identity authentication so users can sign in/out and the app can associate subscriptions, comments, and likes with a unique user identity.

Build VOD browsing and playback UI: a home/browse page that lists videos (thumbnail + title) and a video detail page that plays the selected video on-demand with title/description and engagement controls.

Implement subscriptions: users can subscribe/unsubscribe to Pleiades TV (global subscription) and view their subscription status. Enforce that only subscribed users can access video playback while allowing non-subscribed users to browse the catalog and see video detail metadata.
Implement video comments: authenticated users can post comments on a video and view a comment list on the video detail page (include author identifier display and timestamp).
Implement video likes: authenticated users can like/unlike a video and see the like count on the video detail page (and optionally on the browse cards). Likes must be one per user per video.

Enable sharing: provide a share action on the video detail page that allows users to copy a shareable URL for the current video to the clipboard (and, when available, trigger the browser’s native share sheet via Web Share API).
Add a simple account/subscription page where an authenticated user can see their principal (or a short form) and subscription status, and can manage subscribe/unsubscribe from there as well.
Add generated static image assets for branding and placeholders, and render them in the UI (store under frontend/public/assets/generated).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Pleiades TV app with video on-demand browsing and playback
Implement user subscriptions (subscribe/unsubscribe and subscription management)

Add backend data models and APIs to support a video catalog and video detail retrieval (at minimum: video id, title, description, thumbnail image URL, video playback URL, duration/created timestamp). Seed the app with a small default catalog so the UI works end-to-end without manual setup.
